name: Shadow Volume Atmospheric Scattering
aliases: Real Time Atmospheric Scattering with Volumetric Shadows
Rendering Algorithm for Participating Media with Shadows
Shadow Volume Atmospheric Scattering — Rendering Algorithm for Participating Media with Shadows
definition: A rendering algorithm that computes atmospheric scattering and volumetric shadows by decomposing the light contribution along a view ray into a sum of differences between lit segments, using shadow planes and stencil buffers to handle occlusion and bounded media.
